title: Collect data
goal: The data the scope named is gathered with its origin recorded: each set with where it came from, when it was read and what it covers, nothing private taken that was not needed, and every gap written as a gap.

steps.do: Read each source the scope named through the venture's own records and connections, and record for each what was pulled, the window it covers and the date it was read.
Leave out any field the analysis does not need, personal information above all, and never copy a record marked private into a working set.
Write what could not be collected and why, a source that was unreadable, a window with no records, a measure nobody was keeping, and say what the analysis therefore cannot claim.
Record the collected sets and their gaps as evidence on the handoff, and raise to the strategy lead whether to start recording something the venture does not keep today.

done_criteria.check: Does every collected set name its source, window and read date, and are the gaps written down with what the analysis cannot claim because of them?
